title: Capability lookups belong in model-catalog.ts and go through normalizeModelId
answers: Where should a new per-model capability lookup live?
Why does the model lookup normalize the model id?
Gateway provider-qualified model id drops to 200k context
body:
Per-model capability lookups sit in products/desktop/packages/shared/src/model-catalog.ts beside `labelForModel`/`accessFlagForModel`, reading `catalogModelFor(modelId)` and defaulting to false/undefined for unknown models. They do not belong in reasoning-effort.ts.
The Python mirror in products/tasks/backend/model_catalog.py (`supports_1m_context`, `supports_fast_mode`) uses `_MODEL_BY_ID.get(normalize_model_id(...))` and must be added to `__all__`.
Normalization matters: the gateway serves some ids provider-qualified, and a raw id check would silently drop the model to the 200k window (per the removed comment).
Keep the `@posthog/shared` re-export in packages/shared/src/index.ts pointing at the new home so call sites don't change.
applies: Adding capability accessors for models in the desktop shared package or the tasks backend catalog
